standard_prerequisites.name: Cohen structure theorem
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the fixed surjection Lambda[[x_1, ..., x_n]] -> A against which all others are compared.

standard_prerequisites.name: Continuous lifting
standard_prerequisites.use: Lifts the fixed map through a given complete surjection R -> A.

standard_prerequisites.name: CI well-defined for polynomial presentations
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the regular-sequence condition between the two presented surjections.

core_obligations: Fix the Cohen ring Lambda and the structure-theorem presentation.
Reduce an arbitrary surjection R -> A to its completion: the minimal-generator criterion and the completion identities R^^/(f)R^^ = A are displayed.

For complete R: lift the fixed presentation to Lambda[[x, y]] -> R (surjectivity adjusted by adding variables mapping to kernel generators), and compare the two presentations in the commutative diagram via the polynomial CI lemma.
proof_roadmap: Normalize by the Cohen presentation, reduce to complete surjections, and close with the polynomial comparison lemma.
difficulty_reason: Standard reduction architecture; each normalization step is displayed with its citation.
